channel.description:
Which channel this belongs to (not set = everywhere). For ESR this is also keyed
from the display version.
channel.title: Channel

excludedDistributions.description: Which distributions this does not apply to.
excludedDistributions.title: Excluded Distributions

maxVersion.description: The maximum version this applies to (less-than comparison)
maxVersion.title: Maximum Version

minVersion.description: The minimum version this applies to
minVersion.title: Minimum Version

name.description: The application(s) this applies to (default/not specified is everywhere)
name.title: Name

experiment.description:
The experiment this section is associated with, if blank it is associated with
any configuration.
experiment.title: Experiment

override.description:
This section will override previous appliesTo sections, but not add new
locations where this engine is deployed to.
override.title: Override

default.description: Whether or not this engine should be default.
default.title: Default Status

defaultPrivate.description: Whether or not this engine should be default in private browsing mode.
defaultPrivate.title: Default Status (PBM)

excluded.description:
The locations to which this section applies. Note: Regions and Locales are
'and'ed together.
excluded.title: Excluded Locations

extraParams.description: Extra parameters for the search engine (aka MozParams)

condition.description: The type of parameter (pref or purpose)
condition.title: Condition

name.description: Name of the parameter that will be used in the search query
name.title: Name

pref.description:
The preference name to get the value from (i.e. browser.search.param.<preference
name>).
pref.title: Preference name

purpose.description: The search purpose that triggers this parameter being appended.
purpose.title: Purpose

value.description:
If this is a purpose type, the value is used as the value of the parameter in
the query
value.title: Value

extraParams.title: Extra Parameters

included.description:
The locations to which this section applies. Note: Regions and Locales are
'and'ed together.

everywhere.description: Set to true to signify that this is included everywhere.
everywhere.title: Everywhere

included.title: Included Locations

orderHint.description: A hint to the display order (higher is a higher rank)
orderHint.title: Order Hint

params.description: Various parameters for the search engines

suggestUrlGetParams.description: Extra parameters for search suggestion URLs (e.g. 'pc=foo').
suggestUrlGetParams.title: Suggestion URL GET Parameters

suggestUrlPostParams.description: Extra parameters for search suggestion URLs (e.g. 'pc=foo').
suggestUrlPostParams.title: Suggestion URL POST Parameters

params.title: Parameters

searchUrlCodes.description: A array of objects - map of parameter name to the parameter value.

name.description: Name of the parameter that will be used in the query
name.title: Name

value.description: The value of parameter (pref or purpose)
value.title: Value

searchUrlCodes.title: Codes

telemetryId.description: The telemetry Id as used for search telemetry.
telemetryId.title: Telemetry Id

trending.description: Details of the url used to fetch trending suggestions

fullPath.description: The url used to retrieve trending suggestions
fullPath.title: fullPath

query.description: The query parameters to send in a trending suggestions request
query.title: query

id.description:
The identifier (local part) of the associated WebExtension should be of the
format example@search.mozilla.org
id.title: WebExtension Id

locales.description:
Overrides the WebExtension locales and specifies to use a particular one.
Ideally this should only be used when really necessary, otherwise considered
deprecated.
locales.title: WebExtension Locales

appliesTo.description:
This section defines the region/locales/application information for where a
search engine is available, and any specifics for that
region/locale/application. If there are no entries in the list, it is considered
to be included everywhere
appliesTo.title: Applies To

telemetryId.description: The telemetry Id as used for search telemetry.
telemetryId.title: Telemetry Id
